description: 경기도 군포시_교통량 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도 군포시. 하위계획인 대중교통, 교통안전 등의 개별계획과 상호 연관성 있는 항목 및 내용을 효율적으로 정리하여 상호 보완적 관계의 종합계획 수립을 위한 현황조사 자료로서 군포시 관내 주요교차로 교통량중. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
